2026_05_SF_SEA.headline: Purdy’s clean pocket collides with Seattle’s stingy coverage
2026_05_SF_SEA.paragraph1: San Francisco’s Brock Purdy has opened the season without taking a sack, but Seattle presents one of the league’s toughest pass-defense tests. The Seahawks have limited yardage and produced takeaways, while their offense needs Sam Darnold to avoid the mistakes that can let the 49ers dictate the game. San Francisco must sustain protection and find efficient underneath answers if Seattle limits explosive passes. The Seahawks, in turn, need their defense to force longer drives without allowing Purdy easy rhythm throws. Third-down execution could decide this NFC West meeting.
2026_05_SF_SEA.model_rationale: Seattle’s coverage and takeaway production challenge San Francisco’s efficient protection. The 49ers need patience against tight coverage, while the Seahawks must avoid handing over extra possessions.
